notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.1
notes.content:
- Reduced the maximum number of centipedes that can exist at one time in Nightmare difficulty from 3 to 2
- Fixed a bug where clicking off the game while in the process of dying causes the gameplay to freeze after respawning
